'''Lieutenant Kollis''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served in the [[Republic Military/Legends|military]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Stationed in [[Aurek Base]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]<ref name="TOR1" /> in [[3642 BBY]],<ref name="Dates">{{TOR dates|2}} As the [[Voidhound]]'s encounters with [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] Kollis occur during Act II of the Smuggler class story, they can be assumed to happen in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] 3642 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> he dealt with the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who would later be known as the [[Voidhound]], who was working as [[Privateer/Legends|privateer]] for the Republic. Kollis first met them while they were [[Raid on Republic Storage Depot AB-119|stealing]] long-range sensors from [[Republic storage depot AB-119|Republic Storage Depot AB-119]], having been tricked by [[Languss Tuno]].<ref name="TOR1" /> Later, Kollis asked the Voidhound about the possibility of acquiring the cloaking technology from the [[White Maw]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and wished him safe journey afterwards.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=class|[[Voidhound|Smuggler]]|Trick or Treat|[[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]}}</ref>
